purpose: Teach: 裏面/デタラメ/マズイ/酔っ払い/いまひとつ/合掌/かみさん/無茶苦茶

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお皿の裏面まで丁寧に洗って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father washes even the back of the plates so carefully.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Gentle pride in her voice. Steady, maternal pace. A small smile caught in the tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの言ったことはデタラメじゃないよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad wasn't making it up.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Clear-eyed, defending without aggression. Direct eye contact in the voice. Sho's small steady conviction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマズイって仰った料理は失敗だったわね
lines.en: Sho, the dish your father said tasted off — that one didn't turn out right, did it.
lines.style: Wry self-deprecation, light and honest. A touch of resigned humor. Not fishing for reassurance, just naming it. Slight upward lilt on the question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが酔っ払い帰宅されたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad came home drunk again today.
lines.style: Soft observation, not alarm. Patient noticing. Small pause after the statement, like he's checking if Mom heard him. No judgment in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、今日の献立はいまひとつ自信がないわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm not quite confident about today's menu.
lines.style: Wry admission to herself and him. Honest uncertainty without apology. Light, almost amused at her own doubt. Warm underside beneath the dry surface.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの仏壇に合掌したよ
lines.en: Mom, I offered incense at Grandpa's altar today.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. Deliberate pacing, each word settled. Not seeking praise — simply reporting something he did that mattered. Sho's gentle gravity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがかみさんって呼ぶの愛らしいわね
lines.en: Sho, the way your father calls me that — it's rather sweet, isn't it.
lines.style: Tender, caught between amusement and genuine feeling. Soft voice, as if sharing something private. A pause before the question, like she's surprised at herself for noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、無茶苦茶な事を言わないようにってお父さんに教わったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me not to say wild things like that.
lines.style: Gentle correction, without any sting. Sho speaking from something he's learned and believes. Earnest closure. Quiet wisdom in a six-year-old's certainty.
